PC: Obtain large-bore IV access and give IV fluids (minimum 1L NS or LR)
Order appropriate labs/blood products— Labs: Type and cross, hemoglobin; blood products: packed red blood cells
Perform complete primary and secondary survey with full exposure/skin exam and vascular exam
Establish definite airway (can by via any oral intubation technique, iLMA, or cricothyrotomy)
SBP: Coordinate final disposition for patient (depends on location of your case, either admit/to OR with surgery or transfer if appropriate)
